objective: Replace M128's 53-bit descriptor with a 35-bit canonical payload, enforce stream-local source ordering across descriptors of one row, make idle ready capacity-only, and replace ambiguous untagged completion with an accepted-last tagged token.

motivation.m129_traffic_observation: Across the frozen held-out module workload, M128's 53-bit payload traffic is 1.269554170x the M125/M127 44-bit row-mask traffic. A 35-bit successor would be 0.838384829x, but this projection is not admitted until the successor RTL is verified.

architecture.stream_local_checks: strictly increasing source IDs inside a descriptor; while a row remains open, block/row identity is stable and the next first source ID is greater than the prior last source ID
architecture.idle_ready_rule: when group_valid is low, group_ready depends only on reset, sticky fault, fill exclusion, and elastic pipeline capacity
architecture.completion_rule: done_valid equals accepted update_last in the same cycle and carries done_block/done_row tags

paper_safe_statement: Commercial VCS verifies a 35-bit compact descriptor K4 fold with exact signed results over 22,752 lanes, cross-row II1, stream-local strict source ordering, capacity-only idle ready, tagged accepted-last completion, deterministic and long backpressure, and four fail-closed protocol attacks. Complete row losslessness, external descriptor production, physical frequency, macro PPA, system speedup and headline claims remain unadmitted.
prohibited_claims: Do not call stream-local monotonicity a proof that the producer emitted every required source.
Do not describe the external descriptor producer as implemented or free.
Do not call 35 payload bits the complete interface or buffering cost.
Do not claim descriptor-memory energy from traffic bit counts.
Do not claim frequency or physical speedup before matched Synopsys DC evidence and independent review.
Do not multiply the M129 cycle ratio by an unadmitted frequency ratio.
Do not claim end-to-end, system, energy, FPS, best-paper, or headline improvement.
